concept.title: Memory cloud
concept.notation: A is an arbitrary set; x is an object.
concept.hypotheses: Sets and membership are understood in the chosen foundational theory.
concept.statement: Membership x ∈ A asserts that x is an element of A. The negation x ∉ A asserts that x is not an element of A.
concept.visual_mapping: The creatures are a mnemonic for the idea of membership. The cloud edges and positions are decorative and are not a mathematical map.
concept.limitations: This is a memory scene only: the centre, links, distances, number of creatures and motion imply no formal relation, theorem, hierarchy or proof.
concept.source_quote: This is a synthetic demonstration, not an extraction from Gyile’s coursework.
